sentences.en: After I accumulated five years of seniority, I was promoted.
sentences.zh: 我在积累了五年工龄之后得到了晋升。

sentences.en: The data accumulated, but no one systematized and analyzed it.
sentences.zh: 数据越来越多，但没有人对它们进行系统化和分析。

sentences.en: Why does dust accumulate so quickly everywhere in the house?
sentences.zh: 为什么屋子里到处灰尘积得这么快？

senses.zh: 堆积，积累vi.（数量）逐渐增加，（质量）渐渐提高
